# The path filter of ci.yml, macos.yml and gui.yml (.github/ci/changes.sh reads it; docs/develop/ci.md, "Path
# filter"). A row: a glob (`*` matches across `/`) and the jobs a change there can affect; the first row that matches
# wins, and a path no row matches runs everything. ALL: every job below. -: no job (the changes, scripts and gate jobs
# always run). rt-*: runtime.yml's jobs; the rest are drgnx-tiers.yml's tiers.
jobs: rt-linux rt-msrv rt-escape rt-containers rt-android rt-deny rt-fuzz rt-macos unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing

# the outputs the workflows pass on: runtime.yml's `only`, drgnx-tiers.yml's `tiers`
list runtime: rt-linux rt-msrv rt-escape rt-containers rt-android rt-deny rt-fuzz rt-macos
list tiers: unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing

# the workflows and CI's scripts, the command and installer, the test harness and its settings, the hooks, the lock
# and the Nidhogg pin (test/container/nidhogg.sh): everything
.github/*                     ALL
.githooks/*                   ALL
.gitignore                    ALL
bin/*                         ALL
install.sh                    ALL
harness/*                     ALL
settings/*                    ALL
etc/drgnx.lock.eld            ALL
test/container/*              ALL
test/support/*                ALL
test/fixtures/*               ALL
# Rust: its tests read core/ and the hub's method table (docs/develop/hub.md), and the Lisp tiers run its binaries
runtime/fuzz/*                rt-fuzz
runtime/*                     ALL
core/*                        ALL
docs/develop/hub.md           ALL
# Lisp outside core/: the tiers; runtime's cargo test reads modules/ too (norn's migration test reads its Lisp)
modules/*                     rt-linux rt-macos unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing
wb/*                          unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing
keys/*                        unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing
init/*                        unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing
etc/*                         unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing
# tests read the docs and the README (generated references, the guide's examples, the scenario configs)
docs/*                        unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing
README.md                     unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing
# a tier's own tests; the unit suite's lints read every test file, and the conformance rows run in runtime's jobs
test/conformance/*            rt-linux rt-macos rt-escape rt-containers unit no-lisp-writes macos timing
test/unit/*                   unit no-lisp-writes macos timing
test/ui/*                     unit no-lisp-writes macos ui timing
test/live/*                   unit no-lisp-writes macos ui timing
test/scenario/*               unit no-lisp-writes macos scenario
test/perf/*                   unit no-lisp-writes macos perf
test/tty/*                    unit no-lisp-writes macos tty timing
# files nothing builds, installs, tests or reads (the leak scan, which reads every file, always runs)
SECURITY.md                   -
LICENSE                       -
LICENSES/*                    -
# any other test/ file (the suite's lists, timing rows, bench, install and bootstrap) matches no row: everything

# bite cases (changes.sh --self-test): PATHS | REQUEST | SELECTOR | RUN | PARTIAL
test wb/drgnx-wb.el                         | -        | -                | unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing | false
test modules/tools/drgnx-browser.el         | -        | -                | rt-linux rt-macos unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing | false
test runtime/crates/huginn/src/lib.rs       | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test runtime/Cargo.lock                     | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test core/drgnx-registry.el                 | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test .github/workflows/ci.yml               | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test test/container/nidhogg.sh              | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test some/new/place.txt                     | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test test/flaky.eld                         | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test SECURITY.md                            | -        | -                | -     | false
test SECURITY.md,LICENSES/GPL-3.0.txt       | -        | -                | -     | false
test docs/guide/modules.md                  | -        | -                | unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing | false
test docs/develop/hub.md                    | -        | -                | ALL   | false
test runtime/fuzz/fuzz_targets/line.rs      | -        | -                | rt-fuzz | false
test test/scenario/buffers-test.el          | -        | -                | unit no-lisp-writes scenario macos | false
test test/unit/ci-workflows-test.el,wb/x.el | -        | -                | unit no-lisp-writes ui scenario perf macos tty timing | false
# narrowed dispatches: what the change needs and the run leaves out, or a selector, makes the run partial
test core/drgnx-registry.el                 | rt-linux | -                | rt-linux | true
test core/drgnx-registry.el                 | unit     | drgnx-registry/  | unit     | true
test wb/drgnx-wb.el                         | ui       | -                | ui       | true
test SECURITY.md                            | unit     | -                | unit     | false
test test/unit/ci-workflows-test.el         | unit no-lisp-writes macos timing | - | unit no-lisp-writes macos timing | false
